title: Claimant Identity Verification Pathways: Entry Requirements and Assurance Levels
content:
Claimant Identity Verification is carried out on one proofing pathway at a time. Six pathways are offered, and each has its own entry requirements and establishes its own identity assurance level once verification on it is complete.

## Pathway entries

### Online Identity Proofing (IAL2)
- **Device:** a smartphone or a webcam.
- **Document:** an unexpired primary photo identity document.
- **Email of record:** required.
- **Assurance level established:** IAL2.

### Video Trusted Referee Session
- **Device:** a webcam and a microphone.
- **Appointment:** booked.
- **Document:** a primary photo identity document.
- **Assurance level established:** IAL2.

### In-Person Proofing — American Job Center
- **Location:** the Lakeland American Job Center.
- **Documents:** original primary and secondary documents.
- **Proof of address:** required.
- **Assurance level established:** IAL2.

### In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location
- **Location:** a participating USPS retail office.
- **Barcode:** issued online.
- **Document:** an unexpired primary photo identity document.
- **Assurance level established:** IAL2.

### Documentary Verification by Mail
- **Submission:** photocopies sent by postal mail.
- **Documents:** primary, secondary and proof-of-address documents.
- **Available to:** claimants without internet or travel access.
- **Assurance level established:** documentary review.

### Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification
- **Prior record:** the claimant's identity was used on an impostor claim.
- **Report:** a police report or an FTC report.
- **Appearance:** an in-person appointment.
- **Assurance level established:** IAL2.

## Assurance level at a glance

| Pathway | Assurance level established |
|---|---|
| Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) | IAL2 |
| Video Trusted Referee Session | IAL2 |
| In-Person Proofing — American Job Center | IAL2 |
| In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location | IAL2 |
| Documentary Verification by Mail | documentary review |
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | IAL2 |

## Reading the catalogue

- Five of the six pathways establish IAL2; Documentary Verification by Mail is the only pathway whose completed verification is a documentary review rather than IAL2.
- Two pathways take place on a screen (online and video), three involve an appearance or a visit (American Job Center, USPS retail office, identity theft re-verification appointment), and one is conducted entirely by postal mail.
